This post discusses a JSON object:

{"schema":"not actually an MBLOCK document","events":[{"event_id":"ignored"}]}

It also mentions MBLOCK:BEGIN in prose without an end marker on the same line.

MBLOCK:BEGIN v=1
{
  "schema": "com.muteblock.eventJournal",
  "schema_version": 1,
  "document_id": "mbj:fixture:2026-05-20:json-looking-outside",
  "publisher": {
    "quora_profile": "quora-profile:Mock-Publisher",
    "atproto_did": null,
    "display_name": "Mock Publisher"
  },
  "events": [
    {
      "event_id": "evt-fixture-json-looking-outside-001",
      "type": "profile.block.add",
      "subject": "quora-profile:Outside-Json",
      "occurred_at": "2026-05-20T00:13:00Z"
    }
  ]
}
MBLOCK:END
